findings.evidence: Lines 266 and 271 contain identical exhaustive `Fin 120` case splits; `e8Coroot.toFun` at lines 222–223 explicitly defines the second half as the negative of `e8PositiveCoroot`, and `e8Root.toFun` at line 247 is a vector-matrix product.
findings.fix: Prove `e8Coroot_natAdd` by unfolding/reducing the negative branch against `e8Coroot_castAdd`, then prove `e8Root_natAdd` from it using negation compatibility of vector-matrix multiplication.
findings.issue: `e8Coroot_natAdd` and `e8Root_natAdd` enumerate 120 cases with `fin_cases ... <;> decide`, although both are structural consequences of the two-half definition and linearity of `vecMul`.

summary: The sign symmetry is proved by exhaustive evaluation instead of the definitions that make it hold, obscuring the structural reason and making harmless table changes expensive and brittle.
